label: Step 3 Unity bridge server (protocol v1, docs/protocol.md). Declared 2026-10-20 before any bridge run; not tuned.
port_note: Must equal hri_config.json -> link.port in the Unity project. 5000 stays with the older ping health check.
heartbeat_note: Python sends a heartbeat whenever it has sent nothing for heartbeat_s; Unity stops the robot after watchdog_s = 0.3 s of silence.
save_images_note: Every n-th observation's images are saved to the run folder (0 = none) so the transfer can be checked by eye.
perception_note: stub = no people, gesture NONE, labelled 'stub (no perception until Step 4)'. Unity's decisions stay on the scripted baselines while the link runs in shadow mode.
